name: Fleet Intelligence
description: Agent-first fleet analytics and routing, organized by business problem and applicable to any asset mode (car, HGV, e-bike, and beyond). Inspect fleet status, demand density, trips, operator performance, and top origins; analyze dwell, route deviation, and asset utilization; optimize multi-stop routes and compute drive-time isochrones — all scoped to a selectable region and dataset.
capabilities: Inspect fleet status, demand density, trips, operator performance, and top origins for any asset mode
Analyze dwell and congestion hotspots, route deviation, and asset utilization by region
Optimize multi-stop routes, compute drive-time isochrones, and match backload freight
Switch the active region and dataset (mode) across every dashboard and routing tool
sampleQuestions: How many trips and operators are active for the current fleet?
Which operators have the highest average speed?
What are the busiest origin locations this week?
Where are the worst dwell hotspots and congestion by hour?
